cell_line.evidence: In this study, we generated an anti-CD19 CAR-Jurkat T cell line using a locally produced second-generation CD19 CAR construct, enabling us to analyze early proteomic changes crucial for understanding the signaling pathways and mechanisms of action of this CAR-T cell.
SILAC-heavy tagged RAJI B-cells and anti-CD19 CAR-Jurkat T-cells were co-cultured for ten minutes.
